{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|My bow is curved like your slender form,<br />Bending your bow alongside mine in battle,<br />Facing our foes to save our love and clan.<br />If we do not fight we lose our selves;<br />Enemies burn our deeds and love from this world,<br />And we die in anonymity.''|Canthar|<ref name="Sourcebook">''[[Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref>}}
"'''Making War Is Love'''" was a short [[Poet/Legends|poem]] written by the [[Epicanthix]] warrior-[[Chief/Legends|chief]] [[Canthar]], who united many of his people's clans during their dark ages.
